items.text: Fields of Sight: an equal, ongoing collaboration between photographer Gauri Gill (b. 1970) and Warli artist Rajesh Vangad (b. 1975), begun in early 2013 in Ganjad, Dahanu, an Adivasi village in coastal Maharashtra. Gill's black-and-white photographs of the landscape are inscribed with Vangad's Warli drawings.
